summary: Use the product's own capitalization for application names and lowercase for commands (vi is always lowercase), and write 'because' instead of 'as' when that's the meaning.
questions: How do I capitalize application names versus commands?

answer_card.title: Applications and 'as'
answer_card.answer_md: Use the product's capitalization as a name (GNUPro, Source-Navigator) and lowercase for commands ("type `gcc`"); `vi` is always lowercase. Don't use "as" to mean "because"; say "because".
